<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def eyes(f):
    return tuple(sorted([(n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='S']))
def timer(f):
    return sum(n['pixels'] for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='W')
def term():
    r=last_action_result
    return any(r.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete'))
print("start:",eyes(current_frame),"timer",timer(current_frame),"step",current_frame.step)
# test each action once from start, then reverse
for a,rev in [('UP','DOWN'),('DOWN','UP'),('LEFT','RIGHT'),('RIGHT','LEFT')]:
    s0=eyes(current_frame)
    action([a]); s1=eyes(current_frame); t=term()
    print(f"{a}: {s0} -> {s1} {'TERM' if t else ''}")
    if t: break
    if s1!=s0: action([rev])
print("back to:",eyes(current_frame),"timer",timer(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
